packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP01 vv001-019
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP01
Unit: 6:1–19 (19 verses)
Surah tag: Meccan by the traditional list; 165 verses
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

Praise to God who created the heavens and the earth and made the darknesses and the light; then those who disbelieve equate with their Lord. He created you from clay, then decreed a term, and a named term with Him; then you are in doubt. He is God in the heavens and the earth; He knows your secret and your open, and what you earn. No sign of their Lord’s signs comes to them but they turn from it. They denied the truth when it came; news of what they mocked will reach them. Have they not seen how many a generation We destroyed before them, whom We established in the earth as We have not established you, and We sent the sky on them in abundance and made the rivers run under them; then We destroyed them for their sins and raised up after them another generation. If We had sent down on you a book on parchment and they touched it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said this is only plain magic. They said: why has an angel not been sent down on him? If We had sent down an angel the matter would have been decided; then they would not be respited. If We had made him an angel We would have made him a man and We would have confused for them what they are confusing. Messengers before you were mocked; those who mocked were surrounded by what they mocked. Say: to whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth? Say: to God. He has written mercy on Himself. He will surely gather you to the Day of Rising about which there is no doubt. Those who have lost their souls — they do not believe. To Him belongs what rests in the night and the day; He is the Hearing, the Knowing. Say: other than God shall I take as a walī, Maker of the heavens and the earth, who feeds and is not fed? Say: I am commanded to be the first of those who submit, and do not be of the associators. Say: I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the punishment of a great day. From whom it is averted that day, He has had mercy on him; that is the clear winning. If God touches you with harm, none can remove it but He; if He touches you with good, He is powerful over everything. He is the Overcomer above His servants; He is the Wise, the Aware. Say: which thing is greatest in testimony? Say: God is witness between me and you. This Quran has been revealed to me that I may warn you by it and whoever it reaches. Do you testify that with God there are other gods? Say: I do not testify. Say: He is only one God, and I am free of what you associate.
2–3. Investigation
6:1–3 creation; darknesses and light; clay; a term

Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wa-l-arḍa wa-jaʿala l-ẓulumāti wa-l-nūr. Then those who disbelieve yaʿdilūn — they equate / set up equals. Created from clay; a term decreed and a named term with Him; you dispute. He is God in the heavens and the earth; secret, open, and earnings are known.

Darknesses are plural; light is singular. Clay-creation already sits with Adam (3:59; 15:26 later). Two terms: one decreed (ajal), one named with Him — often heard as death-term and resurrection-term. Level 1 is two ajals and a dispute.

QB-0133: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Gen 1 light-and-dark and with clay/dust human (Gen 2:7; 3:19). DIFFERENCE: Genesis sequences light before the named luminaries; this verse pairs darknesses and light as made, then charges equating. No six-day frame here.
6:4–11 signs turned from; parchment-book still called magic; why no angel

Every sign they turn from. They denied the ḥaqq; the news of what they mocked will reach them. Generations established more firmly than you, sky and rivers given, then destroyed for sins, another generation raised. If a book came down on qirṭās and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would still say magic. Why no angel? If an angel came the matter would be decided; no respite. If We made the messenger an angel We would have made him a man and confused them with their own confusion. Messengers before you were mocked; the mockers were surrounded.

The parchment-counterfactual is this surah’s answer to “give us a physical book.” Touch would not break the magic-charge. The angel-demand is answered as: an angel-arrival ends the test; an angel-messenger would still look like a man. Mockery of messengers is already 21:41 / 36:30 territory; here it opens the Meccan long-file.
6:12–18 He wrote mercy on Himself; feeds and is not fed

To whom belongs the heavens and the earth? To God. He has written mercy on Himself (kataba ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥma). He will gather you to a Day of Rising without doubt. Those who lost their souls do not believe. Night and day are His. Shall I take other than God as walī — Maker, who feeds and is not fed? I am commanded to be first of those who submit (awwala man aslama); do not be of the associators. I fear, if I disobey, a great day’s punishment. From whom it is averted that day, He has mercy; that is the clear winning. Harm: none removes it but He. Good: He is powerful over everything. Overcomer above His servants; Wise, Aware.

Kataba ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥma is one of the strongest self-binding mercy sentences so far (repeats at 6:54). Feeds and is not fed is an anti-idol hunger test, cousin to 5:75’s they-ate-food test aimed at Jesus and Mary. First-of-those-who-submit is this messenger’s self-location inside islām as an act, not yet as the perfected-dīn slogan of 5:3.

QB-0134: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with God as owner of heaven and earth (Ps 24:1; Deut 10:14) and with mercy as a named attribute. The self-written mercy is this wording. Feeds-and-is-not-fed contrasts with offerings that feed a god (pagan cult; also Psalm 50:12–13 God does not eat bulls).
6:19 greatest testimony; this Quran warns whoever it reaches

What is greatest in shahāda? God is witness between me and you. This Quran was revealed to me to warn you by it and whoever it reaches (wa-man balagh). Do you testify that with God there are other gods? I do not testify. He is only one God. I am free of what you associate.
Man balagh extends the warning past the first addressees. The messenger refuses co-testimony to other gods. Tawḥīd here is a refused-shahāda plus a barāʾa from shirk.

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP02 vv020-041
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP02
Unit: 6:20–41 (22 verses)
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

Those given the Book recognize it / him as they recognize their sons. Those who lost their souls do not believe. Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against God or denies His signs? The unjust do not succeed. The day We gather them all, then say to those who associated: where are your partners that you claimed? Then their fitna will be only to say by God our Lord we were not associators. See how they lie against themselves; what they invented has gone from them. Among them is one who listens to you; We have put covers on their hearts lest they understand it, and in their ears a heaviness. If they see every sign they will not believe in it. When they come to you they argue: this is only legends of the ancients. They forbid from it and they keep far from it; they destroy only themselves and they do not perceive. If you could see when they are stood at the Fire: would that we were returned and we would not deny our Lord’s signs and we would be of the believers. No — what they used to hide has appeared to them. If they were returned they would go back to what they were forbidden; they are liars. They said there is nothing but our life of this world; we will not be raised. If you could see when they are stood before their Lord: is this not the truth? Yes, by our Lord. Taste the punishment for that you used to disbelieve. Lost are those who deny the meeting with God until, when the Hour comes on them suddenly, they say alas for us that we neglected it; they carry their burdens on their backs. How evil is what they bear. The life of this world is only play and diversion; the last home is better for those who fear. Will you not understand? We know that what they say grieves you. They do not deny you, but the ẓālimūn deny the signs of God. Messengers before you were denied and they were patient with the denial and the harm until Our help came to them. None can change the words of God. There has come to you some of the news of the messengers. If their turning away is hard on you, then if you can seek a tunnel in the earth or a ladder in the sky to bring them a sign — if God willed He would have gathered them on the guidance. Do not be of the ignorant. Only those who hear respond. The dead — God will raise them; then to Him they are returned. They said: why has a sign not been sent down on him from his Lord? Say: God is able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know. There is no creature in the earth nor a bird flying with its two wings but they are communities like you. We have neglected nothing in the Book. Then to their Lord they will be gathered. Those who deny Our signs are deaf and dumb in darknesses. Whom God wills He leads astray; whom He wills He puts on a straight path. Say: have you seen if God’s punishment comes to you or the Hour comes to you, will you call on other than God if you are truthful? No — on Him you will call, and He will remove what you call Him for if He wills, and you will forget what you associate.
2–3. Investigation
6:20 recognize it as they recognize their sons

Same formula as 2:146. Pronoun: the Book / this sending / the messenger — tafsir splits. Level 1 is recognition-as-of-sons plus a soul-loss sentence for those who still do not believe. QCA-0004 thickens: prior-Book people are credited with recognition, then charged with not acting on it.
6:21–24 invented lie; where are your partners

Worst ẓulm: invent a lie against God or deny His signs. At the gathering: where are the partners you claimed? Their only fitna-speech: by God our Lord we were not associators. They lie against themselves; what they invented has stranded them. The courtroom here is shirk-partners failing their clients — not the 5:116 Jesus-courtroom, a different dock.
6:25–28 covers on hearts; Fire-wish; they would go back

Some listen to you; covers on hearts, heaviness in ears. Every sign will not produce īmān. They say asāṭīr al-awwalīn. They bar others and stay far themselves. Stood at the Fire: would that we were returned. What they hid has appeared. If returned they would go back to what they were forbidden; they are liars.
The return-wish is refused as a lie about their own future. This is one of the Quran’s hardest anti-deathbed-reform sentences: the Fire does not rewrite the will; it only uncovers it.
6:29–32 no rising; play of this world

They said: nothing but this life; we will not be raised. Stood before their Lord: is this not the truth? Yes, by our Lord. Taste. Lost are those who deny the meeting until the Hour comes suddenly; burdens on their backs. This world is play and diversion; the last home is better for those who fear.
6:33–36 they do not deny you; tunnel or ladder

What they say grieves you. They do not deny you; the ẓālimūn deny God’s signs. Messengers before were denied and were patient until help came. None can change God’s words. If their turning is hard on you — a tunnel in the earth or a ladder in the sky to bring a sign — if God willed He would have gathered them on guidance. Do not be of the ignorant. Only those who hear respond. The dead God will raise.

A pastoral sentence to the messenger: the insult is aimed at the signs, not at your person. The tunnel/ladder is a counterfactual: you cannot force a sign that gathers them. Guidance-gathering is God’s if He wills.
6:37–41 why no sign; communities of creatures; if punishment came

Why has a sign not been sent down? God is able; most do not know. No creature in the earth nor bird on two wings but they are umam like you. We have neglected nothing in the Book. Then to their Lord they are gathered. Deniers: deaf, dumb, in darknesses. Whom He wills He leads astray; whom He wills He puts on a straight path. If punishment or the Hour came, would you call other than God? No — Him you will call, and you will forget what you associate.

QB-0136: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with creatures under God’s care (Ps 104; Matt 6:26; 10:29 sparrows). The umam-like-you sentence is this verse’s own: animals as communities, not only as food or symbol. ‘Neglected nothing in the Book’ is a completeness claim about the kitāb (heavenly / this sending — argued). Distress-call that drops the partners is a tawḥīd-under-duress test.

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP03 vv042-058
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP03
Unit: 6:42–58 (17 verses)
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

We sent to nations before you and seized them with misery and hardship that they might humble themselves. If only when Our violence came they had humbled themselves; but their hearts hardened and Satan made what they were doing fair. When they forgot what they were reminded of We opened for them the doors of everything; until when they rejoiced in what they were given We seized them suddenly and they were mute. Cut off was the last remnant of the people who did ẓulm. Praise to God, Lord of the worlds. Say: have you seen if God took your hearing and your sights and sealed your hearts, who is a god other than God to bring it back to you? See how We turn the signs; then they turn away. Say: have you seen if God’s punishment comes to you suddenly or openly, will any be destroyed except the unjust people? We send the messengers only as bringers of good news and warners. Whoever believes and puts things right — no fear on them and they shall not grieve. Those who deny Our signs — the punishment touches them for that they were defiant. Say: I do not say to you I have the treasures of God, nor that I know the unseen, nor that I am an angel. I follow only what is revealed to me. Say: is the blind equal to the seeing? Will you not reflect? Warn with it those who fear being gathered to their Lord — they have no walī or intercessor besides Him — that they may fear. Do not drive away those who call their Lord morning and evening wanting His face. You are not accountable for them in anything and they are not accountable for you in anything, that you should drive them away and so be of the ẓālimūn. Thus We have tested some of them by others, that they may say are these the ones God has favored among us? Is God not knowing of the thankful? When those who believe in Our signs come to you, say: peace upon you. Your Lord has written mercy on Himself: whoever of you does evil in ignorance then turns after that and puts things right — He is forgiving, merciful. Thus We set out the signs so the path of the criminals becomes clear. Say: I am forbidden to worship those you call besides God. Say: I will not follow your desires; I would then have gone astray and I would not be of the guided. Say: I stand on a clear proof from my Lord and you have denied it. I do not have what you seek to hasten. Judgment is only God’s. He recounts the truth and He is the best of deciders. Say: if I had what you seek to hasten, the matter would have been decided between me and you. God knows best the unjust.
2–3. Investigation
6:42–45 seized after the doors were opened

Nations before: misery and hardship that they might humble themselves. They did not. Hearts hardened; Satan made their work look fair. When they forgot the reminder We opened the doors of everything; when they rejoiced in what they were given We seized them suddenly; they were mublisūn. The last of the ẓālim people was cut off. Praise to God, Lord of the worlds.
A three-beat pedagogy: squeeze, then open every door, then seize at the peak of ease. Prosperity after forgetting is not a blessing-verdict in this verse. It is the setup for the snatch.
6:46–49 if He took hearing and sight; messengers only announce

If God took your hearing and sights and sealed the hearts, which god brings them back? If punishment comes suddenly or openly, only the unjust people are destroyed. Messengers: mubashshirīn and mundhirīn. Who believes and puts right: no fear, no grief. Who deny the signs: punishment for that they were defiant.
The no-fear formula of 2:62 / 5:69 is here tied to īmān plus iṣlāḥ after a messenger-pair of good-news and warning. Not a rival to QI-0004; a narrower application.
6:50 I do not have the treasures; I am not an angel
Lā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāʾinu llāh wa-lā aʿlamu l-ghayb wa-lā aqūlu lakum innī malak. I follow only what is revealed to me. Is the blind equal to the seeing?

Three refused claims: treasures, unseen-knowledge, angel-nature. The messenger’s self-description is follower-of-revelation. 6:59 will put the keys of the unseen with God alone — this verse is the human-side of that split.

QB-0137: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with prophet-limits (Num 12:6–8 Moses is not the unseen’s owner; Acts 14:15 we are men). CONTRAST with any later maximal prophetology that makes him knower of the ghayb as a standing property. Level 1 here is a refusal.
6:51–54 do not drive away those who call; peace; mercy written again

Warn those who fear being gathered — no walī or intercessor besides Him. Do not drive away those who call their Lord morning and evening wanting His face. You are not accountable for them. Test: some by others, so they say are these the ones God favored? When believers in the signs come, say peace upon you. Your Lord has written mercy on Himself — whoever does evil in ignorance then turns and puts right: He is forgiving, merciful.

Asbāb often name the poor Companions vs Quraysh dignity-tests. TRADITION for the names. Level 1 is: do not dismiss morning-and-evening callers for a social ranking; mercy is again written on God’s self (6:12); ignorance-then-tawba-then-iṣlāḥ is the door.
6:55–58 I stand on a clear proof; judgment is God’s; I do not have what you hasten

Signs set out so the criminals’ path is clear. Forbidden to worship what they call. I will not follow your desires. I stand on a bayyina from my Lord; you have denied it. I do not have what you seek to hasten. Judgment is only God’s. He tells the truth; He is best of separators. If I had what you hasten, the matter would already be decided between me and you.
The hastening is the demanded punishment / Hour. The messenger does not hold it. 6:58 is the twin of 6:50: neither treasures nor the awaited blow are in his hand.

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP04 vv059-073
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP04
Unit: 6:59–73 (15 verses)
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

With Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. He knows what is in the land and the sea. No leaf falls but He knows it. No grain in the darknesses of the earth, no wet and no dry, but it is in a clear book. He takes you by night and knows what you have earned by day, then He raises you in it that a named term may be completed; then to Him is your return; then He will tell you what you used to do. He is the Overcomer above His servants. He sends over you keepers until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take him and they do not fail. Then they are returned to God their true Patron. Judgment is His; He is swiftest of reckoners. Say: who delivers you from the darknesses of land and sea — you call Him in tattered humility and in secret: if He delivers us from this we will be of the thankful? Say: God delivers you from it and from every distress; then you associate. Say: He is able to send on you a punishment from above you or from under your feet or to mix you as parties and make some of you taste the violence of others. See how We turn the signs that they may understand. Your people have denied it and it is the truth. Say: I am not a wakīl over you. Every news has a settlement; you will know. When you see those who plunge into Our signs, turn from them until they plunge into other talk. If Satan makes you forget, do not sit after the reminder with the unjust people. Those who fear are not accountable for them in anything, but a reminder; perhaps they will fear. Leave those who take their dīn as play and diversion and whom the life of this world has deceived. Remind by it lest a soul be given up for what it earned — it has no walī or intercessor besides God; if it offered every equivalent it would not be taken. Those are the ones given up for what they earned. For them a drink of ḥamīm and a painful punishment for that they were disbelieving. Say: shall we call besides God what neither benefits us nor harms us, and be turned back on our heels after God has guided us — like one whom the satans have lured in the earth, bewildered, while he has companions calling him to the guidance: come to us? Say: God’s guidance is the guidance. We have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds, and to establish prayer and fear Him. He is the one to whom you will be gathered. He is the one who created the heavens and the earth in truth. The day He says Be, it is. His word is the truth. The kingdom is His the day the trumpet is blown. Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Wise, the Aware.
2–3. Investigation
6:59 keys of the unseen; not a leaf
Wa-ʿindahu mafātiḥu l-ghaybi lā yaʿlamuhā illā hū. Land and sea. No leaf falls but He knows it. No grain in the earth’s darknesses, no wet, no dry, except in a kitāb mubīn.

This is the God-side of 6:50. The messenger does not have the treasures or the ghayb; the keys are here. Later ḥadīth lists five keys (Hour, rain, wombs, tomorrow’s earning, place of death — 31:34). TRADITION for the five. Level 1 is: keys with Him alone; leaf, grain, wet, dry, a clear book.
QB-0138: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with sparrow / hairs numbered (Matt 10:29–30) and with Ps 139’s inescapable knowledge. The leaf-and-grain inventory is this verse’s own density.
6:60–62 night-taking; keepers; death-messengers

He takes you by night (yatawaffākum bi-l-layl) and knows what you earned by day, then raises you in it so a named term is completed. Overcomer above His servants. He sends keepers. When death comes, Our messengers take him; they do not fail. Returned to God their true mawlā. Judgment His; swiftest of reckoners.

Tawaffā of sleep is the same verb as 3:55 / 5:117 of Jesus. Sleep is a nightly taking; waking is a raising inside the term. Death is another taking by messengers who do not miss. Three tawaffā-slots: sleep, Jesus-file, ordinary death. Do not flatten them into one doctrine; record the shared verb.
6:63–67 delivered from land-and-sea dark; then you associate

Who delivers you from the darknesses of land and sea — you call Him torn and secret: if He saves us we will be thankful? God delivers you from it and from every distress; then you associate. He is able to send a punishment from above or from under your feet or to mix you as parties. Your people have denied it and it is the truth. I am not a wakīl over you. Every news has a mustaqarr; you will know.
Distress-tawḥīd again (6:40–41). Delivery then shirk is the pattern. The messenger is not their appointed manager.
6:68–70 turn from those who plunge into the signs

When you see them plunge into Our signs, turn away until they change talk. If Satan makes you forget, do not sit after the reminder with the ẓālim people. Those who fear are not accountable for them except as a reminder. Leave those who take dīn as play, whom this world has deceived. Remind lest a soul be given up for what it earned — no walī, no intercessor; every equivalent refused. Drink of ḥamīm.
A seating-rule: do not sit the plunge. Forgetfulness is allowed as a Satan-touch; the reminder restarts the duty. Ransom-at-the-end is refused again (5:36 already).
6:71–73 God’s guidance is the guidance; Be and it is

Shall we call what neither benefits nor harms and turn on our heels after guidance — like one lured by satans, bewildered, while companions call him: come to us? God’s guidance is the guidance. We were commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds, establish prayer, fear Him. He created heavens and earth in truth. The day He says Be, it is. His word is the truth. Kingdom His the day the trumpet is blown. Knower of unseen and witnessed.
Kun fa-yakūn returns (2:117; 3:47, 59). Trumpet day is named. The bewildered-man simile is this unit’s picture of shirk after guidance.

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP05 vv074-090
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP05
Unit: 6:74–90 (17 verses)
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

When Abraham said to his father Āzar: do you take idols as gods? I see you and your people in clear error. Thus We showed Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be of those who are certain. When the night covered him he saw a star. He said this is my lord. When it set he said I do not love those that set. When he saw the moon rising he said this is my lord. When it set he said unless my Lord guides me I will be of the people who go astray. When he saw the sun rising he said this is my lord; this is greater. When it set he said O my people I am free of what you associate. I have turned my face to the One who originated the heavens and the earth, ḥanīfan, and I am not of the associators. His people argued with him. He said: do you argue with me about God when He has guided me? I do not fear what you associate unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge. How should I fear what you associate when you do not fear that you have associated with God that for which He sent down no authority? Which of the two parties has more right to security, if you know? Those who believe and do not mix their īmān with ẓulm — they have security and they are guided. That is Our ḥujja We gave Abraham against his people. We raise in degrees whom We will. Your Lord is Wise, Knowing. We gave him Isaac and Jacob; each We guided. Noah We guided before. Of his descendants: David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, Aaron — thus We repay the good-doers. Zechariah, John, Jesus, Elias — each of the righteous. Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah, Lot — each We preferred over the worlds. And of their fathers and descendants and brothers; We chose them and guided them to a straight path. That is God’s guidance; He guides by it whom He wills of His servants. If they had associated, what they did would have been fruitless. Those are the ones We gave the Book and the ḥukm and the prophethood. If these disbelieve in it, We have entrusted it to a people who are not disbelievers in it. Those are the ones God has guided; so follow their guidance. Say: I ask you no wage for it. It is only a reminder to the worlds.
2–3. Investigation
6:74 Āzar

Abraham’s father is named Āzar and charged with taking idols as gods. Genesis names Terah (Gen 11:26–32). Tafsir and polemic argue whether Āzar is Terah, an uncle, or a title. Level 1 is the name Āzar plus an idol-charge. QB-0144: SAME ROLE (father/household idolatry), DIFFERENT NAME.
6:75–79 star, moon, sun — they set

God shows him the malakūt of heaven and earth so he will be certain. Night covers him. A star: this is my lord. It sets: I do not love those that set. Moon rising: this is my lord. It sets: unless my Lord guides me I will go astray. Sun rising: this is my lord; this is greater. It sets: I am free of what you associate. I have turned my face to the One who originated heavens and earth, ḥanīfan; I am not of the associators.

Tafsir splits: a genuine search staged for his people, or a rhetorical trap. Level 1 is the three-beat: claim, setting, rejection. What fails is not brightness. What fails is afala — going down. A lord that disappears is refused.

QB-0145: This is not Genesis 1 day 4 (luminaries as lamps and signs). It is not Gen 15’s star-covenant (descendants as stars). It is a polemic against taking the lamps as rabb. Nearest cousins are later Jewish and Christian anti-astral polemic and Wis 13’s critique of nature-worship — POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP, not a Genesis scene. CONTRAST with any reading that makes Abraham an astronomer converting himself from scratch; 6:75 says We showed him so he would be certain.
6:80–83 argument; ḥujja; security without ẓulm

His people argue. He does not fear their associates unless his Lord wills. How should I fear what you associate when you do not fear associating that for which no authority was sent down? Those who believe and do not mix īmān with ẓulm have security and guidance. That is Our ḥujja given to Abraham against his people. Degrees raised. Wise, Knowing.
Ẓulm here is heard in tafsir as shirk (via 31:13). Level 1 is īmān unmixed with ẓulm as the security-condition.
6:84–90 the gift-list

Isaac and Jacob given and guided. Noah guided before. From his descendants: David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, Aaron. Then Zechariah, John, Jesus, Elias — righteous. Then Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah, Lot — preferred over the worlds. Fathers, descendants, brothers chosen and guided. If they had associated, their work would be fruitless. These were given Book, ḥukm, prophethood. If these (present addressees) disbelieve, We have entrusted it to a people who will not. Follow their guidance. No wage. A reminder to the worlds.
Jesus sits in the righteous cluster with John and Zechariah and Elias — a messenger among the guided descendants, not singled out here. Ishmael is in the third cluster with Elisha, Jonah, Lot.

QB-0146: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with the Genesis–Kings prophet names. ORDER is not the biblical chronology (Job and Jonah sit in mixed lists; Lot is ‘of his descendants’ in a loose sense). Book-ḥukm-prophethood triad is this verse’s gift-formula.

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP06 vv091-110
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP06
Unit: 6:91–110 (20 verses)
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

They did not measure God with true measure when they said God has not sent down anything on a human. Say: who sent down the Book that Moses brought as light and guidance for the people? You make it into parchments, disclosing some and hiding much. You were taught what you did not know, you nor your fathers. Say: God. Then leave them in their plunge playing. This is a Book We sent down, blessed, confirming what is before it, that you may warn the mother of towns and those around it. Those who believe in the hereafter believe in it and they keep their prayer. Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against God or says it has been revealed to me when nothing has been revealed to him, or who says I will send down the like of what God has sent down? If you could see when the ẓālimūn are in the floods of death and the angels stretch their hands: give up your souls. Today you are repaid with the punishment of humiliation for what you used to say about God other than the truth and for that you were arrogant toward His signs. You have come to Us singly as We created you the first time, and you have left what We bestowed you behind your backs. We do not see with you your intercessors whom you claimed were partners. The link between you has been cut; what you claimed has gone. God is the splitter of the grain and the date-stone. He brings out the living from the dead and the dead from the living. That is God; so how are you turned? Splitter of the dawn. He has made the night a rest and the sun and moon a reckoning. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knowing. He is the one who made for you the stars that you may be guided by them in the darknesses of land and sea. We have set out the signs for a people who know. He is the one who produced you from a single soul, then a lodging-place and a repository. We have set out the signs for a people who understand. He is the one who sent down from the heaven water; We brought out by it the growth of everything; We brought out from it green; We bring out from it grain piled; and from the date-palm, from its spathe, clusters near; and gardens of grapes and the olive and the pomegranate, alike and unlike. Look at its fruit when it fruits and at its ripening. In that are signs for a people who believe. They have made the jinn partners to God, though He created them, and they have invented for Him sons and daughters without knowledge. Glory to Him; He is above what they describe. Originator of the heavens and the earth. How can He have a child when He has no companion, and He created everything, and He is Knowing of everything? That is God your Lord. There is no god but He, Creator of everything, so worship Him. He is wakīl over everything. Eyes do not reach Him; He reaches the eyes. He is the Subtle, the Aware. Insights have come to you from your Lord. Whoever sees, it is for himself; whoever is blind, it is against himself. I am not a keeper over you. Thus We turn the signs, and that they may say you have studied, and that We may make it clear for a people who know. Follow what has been revealed to you from your Lord — there is no god but He — and turn from the associators. If God had willed they would not have associated. We have not made you a keeper over them and you are not a wakīl over them. Do not insult those they call besides God, lest they insult God in enmity without knowledge. Thus We have made fair to every community their work. Then to their Lord is their return; He will tell them what they used to do. They swore by God their strongest oaths that if a sign came to them they would believe in it. Say: signs are only with God. What will make you realize that if it came they would not believe? We turn their hearts and their sights as they did not believe in it the first time, and We leave them in their excess wandering.
2–3. Investigation
6:91–93 they said God sent down nothing; Moses’ Book; this Book

They did not measure God ḥaqqa qadrihi when they said God has not sent down anything on a bashar. Counter: who sent down the Book Moses brought — light and guidance? You make it qirṭās, disclosing some, hiding much. You were taught what you and your fathers did not know. Say: God. Leave them playing. This is a Book We sent down, blessed, confirming what is before it, to warn Umm al-Qurā and those around it. Believers in the hereafter believe in it and keep the prayer.

Two addressee-hearings live in tafsir: Meccan deniers of any human-revelation, and People of the Book who hide portions. Level 1 is the slogan (nothing sent down on a human) plus Moses’ Book as the counter-example plus parchments disclosed-and-hidden plus this Book as blessed confirmer.

Worst ẓulm: invent a lie against God, or say it was revealed to me when nothing was, or I will send down the like. Death-flood: angels stretch hands, give up your souls. You come singly as first created; intercessor-partners gone.
QB-0147: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Torah-as-light (Ps 119:105; Prov 6:23) and with prophetic ‘who sent this?’ challenges. Hiding-much sits on the tahrīf / kitmān file (QCA-0003).
6:95–99 splitter of grain; stars for guidance; one soul; water and gardens

Fāliq al-ḥabbi wa-l-nawā. Living from dead, dead from living. Splitter of dawn; night a rest; sun and moon a ḥusbān. Stars made so you may be guided in land-and-sea dark. Produced you from a single soul, then mustaqarr and mustawdaʿ. Water from heaven; green; piled grain; date clusters; grapes, olive, pomegranate — alike and unlike. Look at the fruit when it fruits.
The lamps here are guidance-tools in darkness, not rabb (6:76–78 just refused that). Ḥusbān is reckoning — cousin to Gen 1:14’s signs for seasons, not identity with day 4.
QB-0148: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Gen 1:14 luminaries as signs/seasons and with seed-sprouting as a creation-sign. Single-soul already 4:1.
6:100–103 jinn partners; invented sons and daughters; no child because no companion

They made the jinn partners though He created them. Invented sons and daughters without knowledge. Originator of heavens and earth. How can He have a walad when He has no ṣāḥiba, and He created everything? That is God your Lord. No god but He. Creator of everything; worship Him. Eyes do not reach Him; He reaches the eyes.

Son-language is blocked here by a no-companion premise — a different block than 4:171’s ‘do not say three.’ Daughters invented is the Meccan goddess-file (53 later). Jinn-as-partners is this surah’s own pairing.
QB-0149: CONTRAST with NT / Nicene sonship; the argument here is biological-companion logic, not Nicene eternal generation. Record the argument. Do not baptize it as an answer to John 1.
6:104–110 not a keeper; do not insult their gods; sworn they would believe a sign

Insights have come. Who sees, for himself; who is blind, against himself. I am not a ḥafīẓ over you. Follow what was revealed; no god but He; turn from the associators. If God willed they would not have associated. You are not keeper or wakīl. Do not insult those they call besides God, lest they insult God without knowledge. Every community has its work made fair. They swore if a sign came they would believe. Signs are only with God. If it came they would not believe. Hearts and sights turned as they did not believe the first time.

A speech-rule: do not curse their gods so they curse God. A will-rule: if He willed they would not associate — the messenger is not appointed to force it. A sign-rule: the oath that a sign would produce īmān is refused in advance.

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP07 vv111-127
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP07
Unit: 6:111–127 (17 verses)
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

Even if We sent down the angels to them and the dead spoke to them and We gathered everything in front of them, they would not believe unless God willed; but most of them are ignorant. Thus We have made for every prophet an enemy — satans of humankind and jinn — inspiring one another with decorated speech in delusion. If your Lord had willed they would not have done it; so leave them and what they invent. And so that the hearts of those who do not believe in the hereafter may incline to it and be pleased with it and earn what they are earning. Shall I seek a judge other than God, when He is the one who sent down to you the Book explained in detail? Those to whom We gave the Book know that it is sent down from your Lord in truth; so do not be of the doubters. The word of your Lord has been completed in truth and justice. None can change His words. He is the Hearing, the Knowing. If you obey most of those on the earth they will lead you from the path of God. They follow only conjecture and they only guess. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and He knows best the guided. So eat of that over which God’s name has been mentioned if you believe in His signs. What is the matter with you that you do not eat of that over which God’s name has been mentioned when He has set out for you in detail what He has forbidden you, except what you are compelled to? Many lead astray by their desires without knowledge. Your Lord knows best the transgressors. Leave the outward of sin and its inward. Those who earn sin will be repaid for what they used to earn. Do not eat of that over which God’s name has not been mentioned; it is a fisq. The satans inspire their allies to dispute with you. If you obeyed them you would be associators. Is one who was dead, whom We gave life, and made for him a light by which he walks among the people, like one in darknesses from which he does not come out? Thus what they were doing was made fair to the disbelievers. Thus We have made in every town its great ones its criminals, that they may plot in it. They plot only against themselves and they do not perceive. When a sign comes to them they say we will not believe until we are given the like of what was given to the messengers of God. God knows best where He puts His message. Humiliation from God and a severe punishment will hit those who committed crimes for what they were plotting. Whom God wants to guide He opens his breast for islām; whom He wants to send astray He makes his breast tight, constricted, as if he were climbing into the sky. Thus God puts the filth on those who do not believe. This is the path of your Lord, straight. We have set out the signs for a people who take heed. For them the home of peace with their Lord. He is their walī for what they used to do.
2–3. Investigation
6:111–113 even angels and the dead would not produce iman unless He wills

The demanded sign-package is stacked: angels sent down, dead speaking, everything gathered in front of them. Still no īmān unless God wills. Most are ignorant. For every prophet an enemy: satans of ins and jinn, inspiring decorated speech as a delusion. If your Lord willed they would not have done it. Leave them and what they invent. The speech is allowed to work on hearts that deny the hereafter.
This is the hardest will-sentence in the block: even the maximal sign-set fails without His will. Enemy-for-every-prophet is a pattern-claim, not only this messenger’s complaint.
6:114–117 the Book detailed; His word complete; most would lead you astray

Shall I seek a judge other than God? He sent down the Book mufaṣṣalan. Those given the Book know it is sent down from your Lord in truth; do not be of the doubters. The word of your Lord is complete in truth and justice. None can change His words. If you obey most of those on the earth they will lead you off His path. They follow only ẓann; they only guess. He knows the stray and the guided.

Mufaṣṣal plus ‘word completed in truth and justice’ plus ‘none can change His words’ is a completeness-and-stability claim about what was sent down. Book-people are again credited with recognition (6:20). Most-on-earth is a warning against majority-as-proof.
6:118–121 eat what His name was mentioned over; do not eat what it was not

Eat of that over which God’s name has been mentioned if you believe in His signs. Why do you not, when He has detailed what He forbade, except compulsion? Many lead astray by desires without knowledge. Leave the outward of sin and its inward. Do not eat of that over which God’s name has not been mentioned — it is fisq. Satans inspire their allies to dispute with you. If you obeyed them you would be associators.

This is the tasmiya food-rule inside a Meccan surah, sitting next to 5:3–5 already walked (carrion, blood, swine, what was dedicated to other than God; Book-people food opened). 6:121’s fisq is the no-name slaughter. 6:119’s ‘He has detailed what He forbade’ points back at the ban-list. Compulsion exception returns.

QB-0155: PARTIAL AGREEMENT with slaughter-in-the-name / not-to-other-gods (Deut 12:20–27; Acts 15:29; 1 Cor 10:19–21). The Quran’s tasmiya-positive command is this wording. Lev 17’s blood-out plus name is cousin, not identity.
6:122–127 dead given life and a light; great ones of the town; breast opened or tightened

One who was dead, whom We gave life and a light by which he walks among people, is not like one in darknesses who does not come out. In every town the great ones are made its criminals, to plot; they plot only against themselves. When a sign comes: we will not believe until we are given the like of what God’s messengers were given. God knows best where He puts His message. Whom He wants to guide He opens the breast for islām; whom He wants to send astray He makes the breast tight as one climbing the sky. Filth on those who do not believe. This is your Lord’s path, straight. Home of peace with their Lord. He is their walī.
Sign-envy is refused: God chooses where the message sits. Breast-open / breast-tight is the inner side of 6:111’s will-sentence.
4–9. IDs

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP08 vv128-144
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP08
Unit: 6:128–144 (17 verses)
Translations: Arabic primary. Core five on split loci: SI / Haleem / Pickthall / Arberry. Yusuf Ali line-only.
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

The day He gathers them: company of jinn, you have taken many of humankind. Their allies among humans: our Lord, we used one another and we have reached the term You appointed. He will say: Fire is your lodging, abiding, except as God wills. Thus We make some of the ẓālimīn patrons of others for what they earned. Company of jinn and humans: did messengers not come to you from among you, recounting My signs and warning you of the meeting of this day? They say we bear witness against ourselves. Worldly life deceived them; they witness against themselves that they were disbelievers. That is so your Lord will not destroy towns for ẓulm while their people are unaware. For each are degrees of what they did. Your Lord is not unaware of what they do. Your Lord is the Rich, the possessor of mercy. If He wills He can remove you and appoint after you whom He wills, as He produced you from the descendants of another people. What you are promised is coming; you will not escape. Say: O my people, work according to your place; I am working. You will know who will have the home of the aftermath. The ẓālimīn will not succeed.

They assign to God from what He created of tilth and cattle a share: this is for God, by their claim, and this for our partners. What is for their partners does not reach God; what is for God reaches their partners. Evil is what they judge. Likewise their partners made the killing of their children fair to many of the associators, to ruin them and to confuse their dīn. If God willed they would not have done it. Leave them and what they invent. They say these cattle and tilth are reserved; none eat them except whom we will, by their claim. Cattle whose backs are forbidden. Cattle over which they do not mention God’s name — invention against Him. They will be repaid for what they invent. They say what is in the bellies of these cattle is exclusive to our males and forbidden to our spouses; if it is dead they are partners in it. He will repay them for their description. Lost are those who killed their children in folly without knowledge and forbade what God provided them, inventing a lie against God. They have gone astray and were not guided. He is the one who produced gardens, trellised and untrellised, the date-palm and crops of different eat, the olive and the pomegranate, alike and unlike. Eat of its fruit when it fruits and give its due on the day of harvest, and do not waste. He does not love the wasters. Of the cattle, some for burden and some for slaughter. Eat of what God provided you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan; he is a clear enemy. Eight pairs: of sheep two, of goats two. Say: did He forbid the two males or the two females or what the wombs of the two females contain? Tell me with knowledge if you are truthful. Of camels two and of oxen two. Say: did He forbid the two males or the two females or what the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when God charged you with this? Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against God to lead people astray without knowledge? God does not guide the unjust people.
2. Structural Analysis

128–135 courtroom of jinn and humans, then a mercy-and-replacement sentence. 136–140 invented partitions of cattle, tilth, backs, wombs, and children. 141–144 God’s produce and the eight pairs; the invented bans are cross-examined.
3. Verse-by-Verse Investigation
6:128–135 gathered jinn and humans; Fire except as He wills

Jinn charged with taking many humans. Mutual use admitted. Fire is the lodging, khālidīn, illā mā shāʾa Allāh. Messengers from among you — the phrase includes both companies. Towns not destroyed for ẓulm while people are unaware (ghāfilūn). Degrees. He is Rich, possessor of mercy; can replace you. Work according to your place.
The except-as-He-wills on Fire-abiding is a live locus (see §5). Do not turn it into a doctrine of temporary hell from this verse alone.
6:136–140 the cattle-and-child file — why the surah is named

A share of ḥarth and anʿām assigned to God and to partners. The partners’ share never reaches God; God’s share reaches the partners. Children-killing made fair by the partners. Reserved fields. Forbidden backs. No tasmiya. Womb-contents for males only; stillbirth shared. Killing children in folly and forbidding what God provided = loss and invention.

This is not Leviticus’s clean/unclean map. It is a polemic against a human partition of God’s own produce, plus child-killing as a decorated dīn. 6:140 pairs the two inventions: killing children and forbidding provision.
6:141–144 eat, pay the due, eight pairs, were you witnesses

Gardens trellised and not; different eat; olive and pomegranate. Eat when it fruits; give its due on harvest day; do not waste. Cattle for burden and for meat. Eight pairs (sheep, goats, camels, oxen — two each). The question: males forbidden, females forbidden, or what the wombs contain? Were you witnesses when God charged you with this? Inventing a lie to lead astray without knowledge is the worst ẓulm here.
4. Linguistic / Key-Lemma Notes

anʿām — livestock, the surah’s name. ḥarth — tilth. naṣīb — assigned share. shurakāʾ — partners (idols / those who legislate with God). ḥijr — reserved/forbidden. ẓuhūr — backs (riding/burden banned). mā fī buṭūnihā — what is in their bellies. safahan bi-ghayri ʿilm — folly without knowledge. ḥaqqahu yawma ḥaṣādihi — its due on harvest day. thamāniyata azwāj — eight pairs. shahidū — were you present as witnesses.
5. Translation Analysis (core five on split loci)
Return to Arabic after the split. Yusuf Ali only where the fifth line moves the call.
Locus
Split among core five
Return to Arabic
6:128 illa ma sha'a Allah on Fire-abode
SI: except as Allah wills. Haleem: unless God wishes otherwise (to deliver — some gloss). Pickthall: save him whom Allah willeth (to deliver). Arberry: except as God will.
illa ma sha'a Allah is bare. 'To deliver' is a gloss Pickthall/Haleem add. Level 1 is an exception-clause, not a mapped population.
6:136 shuraka'ina
SI: our partners [associated with Him]. Haleem: our idols. Pickthall: (His) partners. Arberry: our associates.
shuraka' = partners/associates. 'Idols' is Haleem's narrowing. Partners can be gods or the human legislators of the share.
6:137 shuraka'uhum zayyana qatla awladihim

SI: their partners have made the killing of their children pleasing. Haleem: their idols have induced many to kill their own children. Pickthall: their (so-called) partners made the killing of their children to seem fair. Arberry: their associates have decked out fair.
Subject is shuraka'uhum. zayyana = made fair / decked out. Haleem's 'idols induced' is interpretive. Killing of children is the object, not a specified method.
6:141 atū haqqahu yawma hasadihi
SI: give its due [zakah] on the day of its harvest. Haleem: paying what is due on the day of harvest. Pickthall: pay the due thereof. Arberry: pay the due thereof on the day of its harvest.
haqqahu = its due. SI's bracket [zakah] is tafsir. Level 1 is a harvest-day due, not a named later-zakat rate.
6:144 am kuntum shuhada'a
SI / Haleem / Pickthall / Arberry all: were you witnesses when God charged you.
No split. The ban-list is unauthorized because they were not present at a charge.

Yusuf Ali on 6:137 (line only): 'Even so, in the eyes of most of the pagans, their “partners” made alluring the slaughter of their children.' Confirms partners-as-subject and alluring/fair, not a method-clause.
6. Theological Findings

God’s produce is already His; partitioning a share to partners is a bad ḥukm. Child-killing as decorated dīn is named loss. Food-bans need a witnessed charge from God; desire-bans are iftirāʾ. Mercy and replacement sit in the same Lord who is Rich.
7. Internal Quran Cross-References

Backward: 6:118–121 tasmiya; 5:103 baḥīra/sāʾiba/waṣīla/ḥām; 5:3 ban-list; 6:100 jinn partners; 17:31 / 81:8–9 child-killing parked. Forward: 6:145–150 the recited ban-list and ‘bring your witnesses.’
8. Biblical Cross-References

Lev 11 / Deut 14 clean animals — a revealed taxonomy, not a partner-share. Molech / passing children through fire (Lev 18:21; 20:2–5; Deut 12:31; 18:10; 2 Kgs 16:3; Jer 7:31) — child-killing in a cult frame. Tithe/firstfruits (Deut 14:22; 26) — a due to YHWH, not a split with partners. Harvest due (6:141) is the nearest cousin.
9. Agreement / Difference Analysis
QB-0156 PARTIAL AGREEMENT with biblical bans on child-sacrifice. The Quran does not name Molech. It names partners who make the killing look fair.
QB-0157 CONTRAST with Lev 11’s clean/unclean list: 6:136–144 attacks unauthorized partitions; 6:145 will give a short revealed ban-list. Do not treat this block as the Quran’s Leviticus.
QB-0158 PARTIAL AGREEMENT with harvest-due / firstfruits. ḥaqqahu is not a rate.
10. Historical Context
Traditional: Meccan and early-Arab livestock taboos (backs reserved, womb-rules, names withheld). Names of specific tribes or idols are tafsir. Level 1 does not require a named cult to stand.
11. Narrative Parallels
No Genesis narrative. Cult-child-killing is the biblical analogue, not a shared storyline.
12. Core Research Question Evaluation
QRQ-0001 tawḥīd: partners who take God’s produce and decorate child-killing. QRQ-0007 law: tasmiya already given; invented bans condemned; harvest due commanded; eight-pair cross-examination.
13–16. Register IDs
ID
Title
QDISC-0281
Jinn and humans gathered; Fire lodging except as He wills
QDISC-0282
Messengers to both companies; towns not destroyed while people unaware
QDISC-0283
Share of tilth and cattle split God/partners; partners' share never reaches God
QDISC-0284
Partners made killing of children fair; reserved fields; forbidden backs; no tasmiya; womb-rules
QDISC-0285
Lost who killed children in folly and forbade God's provision
QDISC-0286
Eat, give harvest due, do not waste; eight pairs; were you witnesses
Child-killing made fair vs Molech / passing through fire
Invented partitions vs Lev 11 revealed taxonomy
Harvest due vs firstfruits/tithe
17. Dictionary Updates
an'am, harth, nasib, hijr, haqq al-hasad, azwaj (pairs), shuhada' (witnesses to a charge).
18. Major-Figure Dossier Updates
God: Rich, possessor of mercy, can replace a people, not unaware, does not love wasters, does not guide the unjust. No new named human figure.
19–20. Provenance / Historical audit
Level 1 text. Child-killing and livestock taboos as practiced details are historically plausible for late-antique Arabia; specific tribal names are not in this block.
21. Executive Checkpoint Summary
The surah’s name arrives. Produce is split badly. Children are killed as decorated dīn. Eight pairs are held up against bans no one witnessed God make.
22. Open Questions / Next
Fire except-as-He-wills stays open (not a mapped empty-hell). Next: 6:145–165 CLOSE — the recited prohibitions, the burdened soul, the ḥanīf prayer of Abraham’s people.

packets.title: S006 Al-Anam CP09 vv145-165
paragraphs: S006 — AL-ANʿĀM — CP09  ·  SURAH CLOSE
Unit: 6:145–165 (21 verses)
Translations: Arabic primary. Core five on split loci.
Date: 11 September 2026
1. Overview

Say: I do not find in what was revealed to me anything forbidden to an eater who eats it except that it be mayta, or blood poured forth, or flesh of swine — it is rijs — or fisq dedicated to other than God. Whoever is compelled, not desiring and not transgressing: your Lord is forgiving, merciful. To those who are Jews We forbade every animal with claws, and of cattle and sheep We forbade them the fat except what their backs carry or the entrails or what is mixed with bone. We repaid them for their defiance. We are truthful. If they deny you, say: your Lord is possessor of all-encompassing mercy, and His violence will not be turned from the criminal people. Those who associate will say: if God had willed we would not have associated, nor our fathers, and we would not have forbidden anything. Likewise those before them denied until they tasted Our violence. Say: do you have any knowledge you can bring out for us? You follow only ẓann and you only guess. Say: to God belongs the decisive ḥujja. If He willed He would have guided you all. Say: bring your witnesses who testify that God forbade this. If they testify, do not testify with them. Do not follow the desires of those who deny Our signs and who do not believe in the hereafter and who make equals with their Lord.

Say: come, I will recite what your Lord has forbidden you: that you not associate anything with Him; good to parents; do not kill your children from poverty — We provide for you and them; do not approach indecencies, what is outward of them and what is inward; do not kill the soul God has made sacred except by right. That He has charged you, that you may understand. Do not approach the orphan’s property except with what is better, until he reaches his strength. Give the measure and the weight in justice. We do not charge a soul except its capacity. When you speak, be just even if it is a near kin. Fulfill God’s covenant. That He has charged you, that you may remember. This is My path, straight, so follow it and do not follow the ways, lest they split you from His way. That He has charged you, that you may fear.

Then We gave Moses the Book, complete for the one who does good, a detailing of everything, and a guidance and a mercy, that they might believe in the meeting of their Lord. This is a Book We sent down, blessed; so follow it and fear, that you may receive mercy — lest you say the Book was only sent down on two groups before us and we were unaware of their study — or lest you say if the Book had been sent down on us we would have been better guided than they. A clear proof has come to you from your Lord, and a guidance and a mercy. Who is more unjust than one who denies God’s signs and turns from them? We will repay those who turn from Our signs with an evil punishment for that they used to turn. Are they waiting except that the angels come to them or your Lord comes or some of your Lord’s signs come? The day some of your Lord’s signs come, no soul will benefit from its īmān if it had not believed before or earned good in its īmān. Say: wait; we are waiting.

Those who split their dīn and became parties: you have nothing to do with them. Their affair is only with God; He will tell them what they used to do. Whoever brings a good deed has ten the like of it; whoever brings an evil deed is not repaid except the like of it, and they will not be wronged. Say: my Lord has guided me to a straight path, a right dīn, the millah of Abraham ḥanīfan, and he was not of the associators. Say: my ṣalāh, my ritual, my living and my dying are for God, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. With that I was commanded, and I am the first of the muslims. Say: shall I seek a lord other than God when He is Lord of everything? Every soul earns only against itself. No bearer of a load bears the load of another. Then to your Lord is your return; He will tell you what you used to differ in. He is the one who made you khalāʾif of the earth and raised some of you above others in ranks, to test you in what He gave you. Your Lord is swift in penalty; He is forgiving, merciful.
2. Structural Analysis

145–150: revealed food-list vs invented list; Jewish extra ban as repayment; bring your witnesses. 151–153: recited prohibition-speech (Decalogue-cousin). 154–158: Moses’ Book then this Book so no ‘two groups only’ excuse. 159–165: no parties; ten-for-one; millah of Abraham; living and dying for God; no transferred load; khalāʾif tested.
3. Verse-by-Verse Investigation
6:145–150 I find only these forbidden; Jews had more; bring witnesses

Four items in what was revealed to this messenger: carrion, poured blood, swine-flesh as rijs, and what was dedicated to other than God. Compulsion exception. To the Jews: every clawed animal, and fat of cattle and sheep except back-fat, entrails, bone-mixed. Repayment for baghy. If they deny you: mercy is wide; violence will not be turned from criminals. The associators’ ‘if God willed we would not’ is refused as ẓann. Decisive ḥujja is God’s. Bring witnesses that God forbade this; if they testify, do not testify with them.

6:145 is the messenger’s revealed eat-list in this surah, tighter than 5:3’s Medinan list (which added strangled, beaten, fallen, gored, beast-eaten, slaughtered on stone-altars, azlām). Do not naskh-solve from here; record both lists.
6:151–153 the recited charge

Come, I will recite what your Lord has forbidden you. Eight charges in two verses plus the path-verse: no associate; parents good; do not kill children from poverty — We provide; do not approach fahishah outward or inward; do not kill the sacred soul except by right; orphan property only with what is better until strength; measure and weight just; no soul charged beyond capacity; speak just even if near-kin; fulfill the covenant; this path straight, do not follow the ways that split you.
Child-killing returns from 6:137/140, now named as poverty-fear, with a provision-promise. Sacred-soul ban except bi-l-ḥaqq returns 5:32’s line without the ‘as if all people’ expansion.
6:154–158 Moses’ Book complete; this Book so you have no excuse; a day signs will not benefit late iman

Moses given the Book complete for the good-doer, detailing everything, guidance and mercy. This Book blessed: follow it. Lest you say only two groups before us had a Book. Lest you say if it had come to us we would have been better guided. A bayyina has come. Who turns from the signs: evil punishment. Waiting for angels, or your Lord, or some of His signs: the day some signs come, īmān will not benefit a soul that had not believed before or earned good in its īmān.
6:159–165 parties; ten-for-one; millah of Abraham; no transferred load

Those who split the dīn into parties: you have nothing to do with them. Good deed: ten the like. Evil: only the like. Guided to the millah of Abraham ḥanīfan; he was not of the associators. Prayer, ritual, living, dying for God; no partner; first of the muslims. No bearer of a wizr bears another’s wizr. Khalāʾif of the earth; ranks as a test. Swift in penalty; forgiving, merciful.
4. Linguistic / Key-Lemma Notes

dam masfūḥ — poured-forth blood. ẓufur — claw. ḥawāyā — entrails. ḥujja bāligha — decisive proof. lā taziru wāziratun wizra ukhrā — no bearer bears another’s load. millah — religious community-way. nusuk — ritual/sacrifice. khalāʾif — successors.
5. Translation Analysis (core five on split loci)
Locus
Split among core five
Return to Arabic
6:145 four-item list

SI: dead animal; blood spilled out; flesh of swine — impure; dedicated to other than Allah. Haleem: carrion, flowing blood, pig's meat — it is foul — or a sinful offering. Pickthall: carrion, blood poured forth, swineflesh — foul — abomination immolated to other than Allah. Arberry: carrion, blood outpoured, flesh of swine — abomination — ungodly thing hallowed to other than God.
mayta / dam masfuh / lahm khinzir fa-innahu rijs / fisqan uhilla li-ghayr Allah. rijs attaches most tightly to swine in the grammar; fisq to the dedication.
6:146 Jewish fat ban

SI: every animal with claws; fat of oxen and sheep except what is on their backs or entrails or mixed with bone. Haleem: animals with claws; fat of cattle and sheep except fat on their backs and in the entrails and what is mixed with bone. Pickthall / Arberry: close.
kulla dhi zufur; shuhumahuma illa ma hamalat zuhuruhuma awi l-hawaya aw ma ikhtalata bi-azm. Back / entrails / bone-mixed are the three exceptions.
6:151 la taqtulu awladakum min imlaq
SI: do not kill your children out of poverty. Haleem: because of poverty. Pickthall: from fear of want. Arberry: from poverty.
min imlaq = from poverty / want. Pickthall's 'fear of want' is a slight widening. 17:31 parked: from fear of poverty.
6:164 la taziru waziratun wizra ukhra

SI: no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Haleem: no soul shall bear the burden of another. Pickthall: no laden soul shall bear another's load. Arberry: no soul laden bears the load of another.
Shared sense. No split that changes the call.
Yusuf Ali 6:164 line only: 'no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another.' Same call.
6. Theological Findings

Invented food-bans lose to a short revealed list. Jews carry extra food-law as repayment, not as the gentile default. A Decalogue-cousin is recited as what the Lord forbade. Late īmān after the sign-day does not count. Loads are not transferable. Living and dying are for God without a partner.
7. Internal Quran Cross-References

5:3 longer ban-list; 2:173; 16:115. 5:32 sacred soul. 6:137/140 child-killing. 2:286 capacity. 16:25 / 29:13 others may carry extra loads of misguidance — tension to flag, not flatten. 2:130 millah of Abraham.
8. Biblical Cross-References

Lev 11 clawed/unclean; Lev 3:16–17 / 7:23–25 fat forbidden to Israel. Exod 20 / Deut 5 Decalogue. Deut 24:16 / Ezek 18:20 the soul that sins shall die; fathers not put to death for children. Corporate confession and original-sin frames in later Christian theology are the contrast-file for 6:164, not Ezekiel’s own sentence.
9. Agreement / Difference Analysis
QB-0159 PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Lev 11/7 on blood, carrion-logic, swine, and Israel-only fat. The Quran assigns the extra fat/claw ban to Jews as repayment.

QB-0160 PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Decalogue structure (other gods, parents, killing, property, speech) plus extras (children-from-poverty, fahishah inward/outward, orphan, weights, covenant, do not split the path). Sabbath is absent here.

QB-0161 PARTIAL AGREEMENT with Ezek 18:20 / Deut 24:16 on non-transfer of guilt. CONTRAST with any theology in which another soul bears your wizr as saving work. 16:25 parked if it thickens the load-file.
10–12. Context, parallels, QRQ
Meccan close of a tawḥīd-and-law surah. No new datable event. QRQ-0007 law: revealed list vs invented list. QRQ-0009 Abraham: millah ḥanīf again. QRQ-0008: no transferred load.

21. Executive Checkpoint Summary

Al-Anʿām closes as it opened: one Lord, no partners, a human who does not own the unseen, a short revealed food-list against invented cattle-taboos, a recited ethic, Abraham’s millah, and a load no one else will carry. Next canonical surah: S007 al-Aʿrāf.

pickthall.name: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ۖ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.itani: Praise be to God, Who created the heavens and the earth, and made the darkness and the light. Yet those who disbelieve ascribe equals to their Lord.
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Who hath created the heavens and the earth, and hath appointed darkness and light. Yet those who disbelieve ascribe rivals unto their Lord.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍۢ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًۭا ۖ وَأَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ۖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.itani: It is He who created you from clay, then decided a term—a term determined by him. Yet you doubt.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath created you from clay, and hath decreed a term for you. A term is fixed with Him. Yet still ye doubt!

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.itani: He is God in the heavens and the earth. He knows what you keep secret and what you make public; and He knows what you earn.
verses.pickthall: He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth. He knoweth both your secret and your utterance, and He knoweth what ye earn.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.itani: Not one of their Lord’s signs comes to them, but they turn away from it.
verses.pickthall: Never came there unto them a revelation of the revelations of Allah but they did turn away from it.

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.itani: They denied the truth when it has come to them; but soon will reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.
verses.pickthall: And they denied the truth when it came unto them. But there will come unto them the tidings of that which they used to deride.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًۭا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.itani: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them? We had established them on earth more firmly than We established you, and We sent the clouds pouring down abundant rain on them, and We made rivers flow beneath them. But We destroyed them for their sins, and established other civilizations after them.
verses.pickthall: See they not how many a generation We destroyed before them, whom We had established in the earth more firmly than We have established you, and We shed on them abundant showers from the sky, and made the rivers flow beneath them. Yet we destroyed them for their sins, and created after them another generation.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَٰبًۭا فِى قِرْطَاسٍۢ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.itani: Had We sent down upon you a book on paper, and they had touched it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said, “This is nothing but plain magic.”
verses.pickthall: Had we sent down unto thee (Muhammad) (actual) writing upon parchment, so that they could feel it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said: This is naught else than mere magic.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌۭ ۖ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًۭا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
verses.itani: And they say, “Why was an angel not sent down to him.” Had We sent down an angel, the matter would have been settled, and they would not have been reprieved.
verses.pickthall: They say: Why hath not an angel been sent down unto him? If We sent down an angel, then the matter would be judged; no further time would be allowed them (for reflection).

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًۭا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًۭا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
verses.itani: Had We made him an angel, We would have made him a man, and confused them when they are already confused.
verses.pickthall: Had we appointed him (Our messenger) an angel, We assuredly had made him (as) a man (that he might speak to men); and (thus) obscured for them (the truth) they (now) obscure.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.itani: Messengers before you were ridiculed, but those who mocked them became besieged by what they ridiculed.
verses.pickthall: Messengers (of Allah) have been derided before thee, but that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride.

verses.arabic: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.itani: Say, “Travel the earth and observe the final fate of the deniers.”
verses.pickthall: Say (unto the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!

verses.arabic: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُل لِّلَّهِ ۚ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۚ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.itani: Say, “To whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth?” Say, “To God.” He has inscribed for Himself mercy. He will gather you to the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. Those who lost their souls do not believe.
verses.pickthall: Say: Unto whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth? Say: Unto Allah. He hath prescribed for Himself mercy, that He may bring you all together to the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. Those who ruin their souls will not believe.

verses.arabic: ۞ وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.itani: To Him belongs whatever rests in the night and the day. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever resteth in the night and the day. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّۭا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ ۗ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.itani: Say, “Shall I take for myself a protector other than God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, and He feeds and is not fed?” Say, “I am instructed to be the first of those who submit.” And do not be among the idolaters.
verses.pickthall: Say: Shall I choose for a protecting friend other than Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, Who feedeth and is never fed? Say: I am ordered to be the first to surrender (unto Him). And be not thou (O Muhammad) of the idolaters.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.itani: Say, “I fear, should I defy my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day.”
verses.pickthall: Say: I fear, if I rebel against my Lord, the retribution of an Awful Day.

verses.arabic: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.itani: Whoever is spared on that Day—He had mercy on him. That is the clear victory.
verses.pickthall: He from whom (such retribution) is averted on that day, (Allah) hath in truth had mercy on him. That will be the signal triumph.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍۢ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
verses.itani: If God touches you with adversity, none can remove it except He. And if He touches you with good—He is Capable of everything.
verses.pickthall: If Allah touch thee with affliction, there is none that can relieve therefrom save Him, and if He touch thee with good fortune (there is none that can impair it); for He is Able to do all things.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.itani: He is the Supreme over His servants. He is the Wise, the Expert.
verses.pickthall: He is the Omnipotent over His slaves, and He is the Wise, the Knower.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَٰدَةًۭ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ ۚ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.itani: Say, “What thing is more solemn in testimony?” Say, “God is Witness between you and me. This Quran was revealed to me, that I may warn you with it, and whomever it may reach. Do you indeed testify that there are other gods with God?” Say, “I myself do not testify.” Say, “He is but One God, and I am innocent of your idolatry.”
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): What thing is of most weight in testimony? Say: Allah is Witness between me and you. And this Qur'an hath been inspired in me, that I may warn therewith you and whomsoever it may reach. Do ye in sooth bear witness that there are gods beside Allah? Say: I bear no such witness. Say: He is only One Allah. Lo! I am innocent of that which ye associate (with Him).

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ۘ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.itani: Those to whom We have given the Book recognize it as they recognize their own children; but those who have lost their souls do not believe.
verses.pickthall: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture recognise (this revelation) as they recognise their sons. Those who ruin their own souls will not believe.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.itani: Who does greater wrong than someone who fabricates lies against God, or denies His revelations? The wrongdoers will not succeed.
verses.pickthall: Who doth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah or denieth His revelations? Lo! the wrongdoers will not be successful.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.itani: On the Day when We gather them all together, then say to the idolaters, “Where are your idols, those you used to claim?”
verses.pickthall: And on the day We gather them together We shall say unto those who ascribed partners (unto Allah): Where are (now) those partners of your make-believe?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
verses.itani: Then their only argument will be to say, “By God, our Lord, we were not idolaters.”
verses.pickthall: Then will they have no contention save that they will say: By Allah, our Lord, we never were idolaters.

verses.arabic: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.itani: Look how they lied to themselves. And what they invented deserted them.
verses.pickthall: See how they lie against themselves, and (how) the thing which they devised hath failed them!

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۚ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.itani: Among them are those who listen to you; but We place covers over their hearts, to prevent them from understanding it, and heaviness in their ears. Even if they see every sign, they will not believe in it. Until, when they come to you, to argue with you, those who disbelieve will say, “These are nothing but myths of the ancients.”
verses.pickthall: Of them are some who listen unto thee, but We have placed upon their hearts veils, lest they should understand, and in their ears a deafness. If they saw every token they would not believe therein; to the point that, when they come unto thee to argue with thee, the disbelievers say: This is naught else than fables of the men of old.

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْـَٔوْنَ عَنْهُ ۖ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.itani: They keep others from it, and avoid it themselves; but they ruin only their own souls, and they do not realize.
verses.pickthall: And they forbid (men) from it and avoid it, and they ruin none save themselves, though they perceive not.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُوا۟ يَٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.itani: If only you could see, when they are made to stand before the Fire; they will say, “If only we could be sent back, and not reject the revelations of our Lord, and be among the faithful.”
verses.pickthall: If thou couldst see when they are set before the Fire and say: Oh, would that we might return! Then would we not deny the revelations of our Lord but we would be of the believers!

verses.arabic: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا۟ لَعَادُوا۟ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.itani: What they used to conceal before will become clear to them. And even if they were sent back, they would revert to what they were forbidden. They are liars.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but that hath become clear unto them which before they used to hide. And if they were sent back they would return unto that which they are forbidden. Lo! they are liars.
